surprise.title: The sea around Cozumel is almost glass today
surprise.body: You are in Cozumel from about 8 AM to 4 PM, and the water could hardly be kinder for snorkeling: forecast waves near the island are only about 7 inches all day, the water is about 85F, and the breeze stays a light 3 to 6 mph. The best window is the morning. Clouds are thin, rain chances are near zero until late morning, and the UV index is still mild before 10 AM, then climbs to about 7 (high) around 1 PM, when it also feels like 95F. After noon, the chance of a passing shower rises to about 30 percent by mid-afternoon. So get in the water early, keep shade and water handy at midday, and leave yourself room to be back aboard well before the 4 PM departure.
